title: Portal 2
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.13, 2026-08-28
notes: Works at 200+ fps under DXVK once HDR is off — and the Portal 2 recipe turns it off for you. The story: Source's HDR path triggers a MoltenVK driver bug (a giant zero-attachment render pass aborts the GPU), which made every map load freeze or crash while menus looked fine. With mat_hdr_level 0 (written into portal2/cfg by the recipe, or set Shader Detail to not use HDR in video settings) the intro runs at 210-216 fps at 1728x1117 with a completely clean device log. Apply the Portal 2 recipe after installing the game, keep the bottle on DXVK. The same root cause likely affects other Source titles (Portal 1, HL2, TF2, L4D2) — the same fix should transfer. Visual cost: Source's HDR bloom, minor in this game.
